# A.A. Gde Yogi Pramana > AI Safety Research Associate at AI Singapore, NTU, and incoming CS PhD student at NUS. Based in Singapore. A.A. Gde Yogi Pramana is an AI Safety Research Associate at AI Singapore, Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore, and an incoming Computer Science PhD student at the National University of Singapore (NUS). ## Education - Master of Computing in Artificial Intelligence, National University of Singapore (NUS), 2026 - Bachelor of Computing, BINUS University, 2026 - Bachelor of Science, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), 2025 ## Research interests AI safety, AI alignment, and cooperative AI. He believes the future of AI will be pluralistic. ## Contact - Email: yogi.p@u.nus.edu - Website: https://igoy.ai/ - GitHub: https://github.com/IgoyAI ## Pages - [About](https://igoy.ai/): biography, education, contact - [Publications](https://igoy.ai/publications/): academic publications - [Projects](https://igoy.ai/projects/): project portfolio - [Sitemap](https://igoy.ai/sitemap.xml): full page index
